description: The OASIS Model Context Protocol server exposes 516 typed commands across WEB4–WEB10 directly to Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients. It covers avatars and identity, karma, holons, wallets, keys, NFTs, providers, HyperDrive, STAR OAPPs, quests, missions, inventory, AI providers, FAHRN agents, BRAID memory, DID/VC, external memory, symbiosis sessions, Galactic Mesh, Singularity and Source operations. Install with: dotnet tool install -g NextGenSoftware.OASIS.MCP.Server. The packaged README explains configuration and the packaged MCP_TOOL_CATALOG.md lists every command, parameter signature and description.
releaseNotes:
- Initial NuGet release as part of the OASIS Omniverse Reboot and Rebrand under oasisomniverse.one.
- Rewrote from Node.js/npm to .NET 10 using the official ModelContextProtocol SDK for improved performance and type safety.
- Consolidated into the OASIS2 repository under WEB6/ — single source of truth alongside Web6.Core and Web6.WebAPI.
- Full integration with OASIS API Core v2.0.0, WEB6 AI abstraction layer, WEB7-WEB10 APIs, FAHRN, HolonicBraid, and STAR ODK.
- 516 typed named tools covering WEB4–WEB10: NFT operations, wallet management, smart contracts, A2A Protocol, avatar/identity, AI completions, FAHRN orchestration, holonic memory, external memory, DID/VC auth, and direct blockchain access.
- Configurable via IDE mcp.json: dotnet tool install -g NextGenSoftware.OASIS.MCP.Server, then point your IDE at the oasis-mcp command.
- Many misc improvements.
- Multiple bug fixes.
title: OASIS MCP Server
